summary: Anbernic's 4-inch Unisoc T618 Android handhelds — RG405M (CNC aluminium, horizontal) and RG405V (plastic, vertical) — running Android 12. Each model's own vendor page carries the NOTICE that third-party OS installation is a one-way street: no flashing back to the official OS, and the warranty becomes invalid. No Linux custom firmware exists for this chip from the community projects tracked here.

specs.cpu: Unisoc Tiger T618, 64-bit octa-core: 2× Cortex-A75 @2.0 GHz + 6× Cortex-A55 @2.0 GHz
specs.storage: 128 GB eMMC; TF card expansion up to 2 TB (vendor claim)

variants.notes: CNC aluminium shell in black or grey. Horizontal layout with hall sticks, six-axis gyro, vibration motor, 3.5 mm jack. Battery life claimed 7 hours, ~2 h charge. The vendor product page carries the one-way-door warning: third-party OS cannot be uninstalled and warranty becomes invalid.
